description: What changed in a tool list since you approved it? Compares "tools" or "url" now with "pin" (set_id from audit_tools/diff_tools) or "baseline" (earlier definitions). Each change is labeled breaking (removed tool or param, new required param, type or enum removal), suspicious (new text with injection patterns or hidden characters), review (description, title, annotation or new tool) or additive; descriptions come with before/after text and a word diff. Returns a new pin. Free: 20 calls/day per IP (shared with audit_tools), then $0.002 via x402 or credits.

baseline.description: Instead of pin: the earlier tool definitions themselves.

pin.description: A pin (set_id "ts_..." from an earlier ToolFit call) to compare against.

tools.description: Tool definitions: MCP tools/list entries, OpenAI {type:"function",function:{...}}, Anthropic {name,description,input_schema}, Gemini functionDeclarations or Bedrock toolSpec. Max 500.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.

name: diff_tools
title: Diff a tool list against a pin (ToolFit)
